title: Execution Request — request wire (v0.2)
description: Public-safe request-only wire object for a governed execution. This object must not carry outcome, acceptance, denial, a result reference, or any decision result. consumer_ref is the submitting consumer or service identity and is not the complete actor model. payload is operation-specific input only and cannot override envelope reference or integrity fields. A valid shape does not grant authority.

request_ref.description: Request identity for this governed operation.

operation_ref.description: Operation identity. Opaque; naming and catalog are out of scope.

consumer_ref.description: Submitting consumer or service identity. This is not the complete actor model.

actor_refs.description: Generic opaque acting identities. Independent of consumer_ref, authority_refs, evidence_refs, and resource_revision_refs.

authority_refs.description: Independent opaque authority references. Presence does not grant authority.

evidence_refs.description: Independent opaque evidence references. Multiple values may be bound to one request.

idempotency_key.description: Consumer-supplied idempotency key. Same key plus the same integrity binding identifies the same request.

nonce.description: Replay-detection nonce. Reuse with a different integrity binding is not the same request.
